{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Joule Campus Gas Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://millardcounty.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Joule-DA-PZ-Public-Notice-Z-2026-026-1.pdf|title=millardcounty.gov|website=millardcounty.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Holden area to McCornick area.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://millardcounty.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Joule-DA-PZ-Public-Notice-Z-2026-026-1.pdf|title=millardcounty.gov|website=millardcounty.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Joule Capital Partners<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://millardcounty.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Joule-DA-PZ-Public-Notice-Z-2026-026-1.pdf|title=millardcounty.gov|website=millardcounty.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://millardcounty.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Joule-DA-PZ-Public-Notice-Z-2026-026-1.pdf|title=millardcounty.gov|website=millardcounty.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Proposed<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://millardcounty.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Joule-DA-PZ-Public-Notice-Z-2026-026-1.pdf|title=millardcounty.gov|website=millardcounty.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
